content: If the certificate is in a well-formatted ASN.1 structure but ba- sic elements as outlined in KeyMCertificateElementOfStructure for the specified for- mat type (KeyMCertFormatType) are missing, the certificate status KEYM_E_CER- 31 of 143 Document ID 907: AUTOSAR_SWS_KeyManager Specification of Key Manager AUTOSAR CP R22-11 TIFICATE_INVALID_TYPE shall be set and reported to the application if required by the configured callback. No further operation like validating shall be performed on this certificate until the status has been reset.
